facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Guaranteed Capital: Yes for selected companies by track
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Build: CLP 15M (~US$15K); Ignite: CLP 25M + possible CLP20M extension; Growth: CLP75M (~US$100K), all equity-free
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: On selection / public grant contract; extension conditional by track/performance
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: 0% equity; government grant under CORFO terms
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Track-specific: Build early-stage; Ignite requires functional product, early validation and <3 years development; Growth for internationalization/scaling.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Hybrid；存在必须/高价值线下节点，主要地点：Santiago, Chile。
facts_raw.International Founder: Yes — programs accept global startups subject to track terms
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Status: Track-specific; Ignite currently says applications opening soon
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Pre-seed–growth tracks 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；只有想法、无 MVP/traction 的极早期项目
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore: create separate child records for Build / Ignite / Growth before showing exact eligibility or grant amount to a founder.
